title: Mirror across center copies a shape about the middle of its icon
goal: Drawing a symmetrical icon today means drawing the second half by hand and lining it up by eye, and a half unit of drift is exactly what people see in a set of icons. Add Mirror across center, as the icon drawing mock draws it: it copies the picked shape reflected about the vertical center line of the frame it sits in, exact by construction.
notes: icon-vector success item 4: 'Mirror across center (Shift Cmd M) copies a shape exactly about the artboard centre'. Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/icon-draw-wt.html lines ~142 and ~493 (#layerMenu: Group selection, Mirror across center Shift Cmd M, Center on the artboard, divider, Union, Outline stroke) and step 7 ('the shoulder is copied to 15, 10, reflected about the artboard's center line'). No Mirror exists in Sources today (grep -i mirror). Shift Cmd M is bound only on timed documents: EditorCommands.swift:1359 'timed ? KeyboardShortcut("m", [.command,.shift]) : nil' (Previous Marker), so the key is free on pictures. The Layers panel menu landed on 2026-10-08 (task the-layers-header-carries-make-component-and-a-p, commit 9916955e). Geometry in PhotonzCore, tested first (a pure reflect of a layer's frame and path about x = c). Do NOT take the mock's Center on the artboard Option Cmd C: that key is Canvas Size (Photoshop parity), note it in rough. Ship behind a Next flag on by default.
acceptance: On a 24 unit icon frame at Next defaults, an ellipse centred at 9, 10 picked and Mirror across center chosen gives a second ellipse centred at 15, 10 with the same size, fill and outline, picked, in one undo step
A path is mirrored point for point, handles included; a shape on no frame mirrors about the canvas's middle

It is in the Layers panel menu (as the mock places it, under Group selection), in the menu bar under Layer, and on the shape's right-click menu, with Shift Command M on a picture or icon document; on a video Shift Command M stays Previous Marker
A walk drawing a half icon and mirroring it runs green at Next defaults, reading the mirrored shape's position

Audit written under queue/audits/ with the app beside icon-draw-wt.html step 7; anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar, and written into this task's log if it does not
